chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Meeting Charlotte in San Francisco, marriage and daughter
summary: Herman met Charlotte in San Francisco while with Tom Garen, married in September 1936 as the band began, and their daughter was born in 1942.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Let me ask you this. When did you meet Charlotte now? Was it in San Francisco?
Yes, we met in San Francisco when we were both extremely young, and she was there working in a show.
Was she a dancer -- wasn't she?
Well, she basically worked as an actress, later doing straight work and doing comedy.
You were with Tom Garen's band at the time?
Yeah. And that's how we met, and then we started an association. At least, we kept in touch with each other. On the road for a period of time, for years, actually. And about six years later --
When did you get married then? What year was that?
The year was 1936, September of '36. And we started the band -- our first job was November, 1936. So we were married a couple of months while we were rehearsing, and recording.
I see. So she began with your -- actually your leadership career.
Yes, that was -- our marriage and the band kind of side by side. Forty-two years.
And when did your daughter come into this world? Ingie.
I see. I ask these questions so that it will fit back into why you were thinking about your family.
So she was a little over four years old.
Yeah. And that's the reason I wanted to be home, to (inaudible) together for awhile.
